en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from his father, from Hammad bin Isa, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:
Complaining is not that a man says: «I became ill yesterday» or «I was ached yesterday». However, complaining is that one says: «I have become afflicted with what none has been afflicted with.»
